_howto: One item per paper figure/table (or panel group). This file is the machine-readable coverage contract:
decision for numeric items: target (with target_ids) | deferred_blocked (with blocker).
decision for non_numeric items: excluded | target.
Allowed blockers: missing_author_data, missing_benchmark_metadata, missing_source_input, insufficient_compute, requires_external_hardware, covered_by_target, user_descoped.
'Supporting', 'low priority', or 'similar to another figure' are NOT blockers: reproduce the item instead.
Coverage means scientific reproduction (independent numerics or analytic references). Digitized curves and copied source panels do not count as coverage.
If scientific input is missing, deferred_blocked with evidence is an honest partial state.

If execution is compute/hardware-limited or a mapped target is reduced_scale, add a code-ready implementation contract: status=ready, case-local code_refs, config config_ref, working_directory=workspace, argv-style entrypoint, expected_outputs, and acceptance_criteria.
Put reusable contracts in top-level implementations and reference them from items with implementation_ref; an inline implementation object is also accepted.
Compute may postpone execution; it may not postpone writing runnable code.

acceptance_criteria: Across-critical Fisher lines cross the time axis while same-phase lines remain in the left half-plane.
The work rate is nonnegative, normalized, and its zero-work cut equals the Loschmidt rate.
The N=256 Majorana-Pfaffian channel passes exact-spin parity and three-scale convergence checks.
Postselection sector switches track Fisher times and corrected normalization identities close.
Literal supplement formulas and independently corrected formulas remain frozen separately for review.
The exact finite-chain return amplitudes preserve norm and approach the published g1-to-infinity limit over the frozen g1 sequence.
The audit never guesses the unpublished 1/g1 expansion or promotes the exploratory finite-chain sequence to a paper-exact correction.

items.reason: All six Fisher branches are generated from the closed formula.
All branches and marked time-axis crossings are generated.
Every printed fixed-work curve is generated by saddle inversion.
The full work-time surface and mean-work ridge are generated with a bracketed saddle solve.
The printed quench is executed independently; the physical precession feature is reproduced, while the exact displayed finite-size/thermodynamic protocol is absent from the paper.
The printed quench is executed independently; the decay feature is reproduced, while the exact displayed finite-size/thermodynamic protocol is absent from the paper.
All four quenches use a formula-derived N=256 Majorana-Pfaffian channel; the oscillation period is reproduced, but the paper omits its fit-shift value and Pfaffian size/distance grid.
Ordinary and ground-sector-postselected magnetizations are independently evolved; their printed curve labels are tested as a paper-discrepancy candidate rather than silently swapped.
Half occupation, critical momentum, period, and Loschmidt nonanalyticity are checked.
Normalization, mean-work derivative, Legendre rate, unique zero locus, and zero-work identity are checked.
Diagonal/off-diagonal sector rates and switching times are generated exactly.
The normalized and literal unnormalized expectations are frozen separately.
The normalized characteristic identity and literal source expression are frozen separately.
